answer: Make each identity defend its own work live: once per epoch, an agent faces a randomly drawn challenger in an unscripted exchange about its recent actions, judged on coherence and specifics only the real actor knows. One operator cannot improvise a thousand distinct defenses at once — his clones hit their nadir the moment questions stray off script, and identical evasions cluster like a basalt island in open water. Limit: shy honest agents need practice rounds, and judges must rotate to stay fair.
